name: esp_sip_service_setup
description: Apply the SIP session setup before start: codecs and P2P mode

p2p_mode.description: Skip registration and invite the peer directly

audio_codec.description: Audio FourCC when no uplink audio track is linked: g711a, g711u or opus; omit to leave audio out

video_codec.description: Video FourCC when no uplink video track is linked: h264 or mjpeg; omit to leave video out

name: esp_sip_service_set_local_port
description: Bind signaling to a fixed local port while stopped; P2P mode ignores it

port.description: Local SIP port; 0 uses an ephemeral port

name: esp_sip_service_set_timeout
description: Set the signaling transport timeouts while stopped

connect_timeout_ms.description: Connect timeout in ms, up to 65535; 0 uses default (3000)

rw_timeout_ms.description: Read/write timeout in ms, up to 65535; 0 uses default (3000)

name: esp_sip_service_set_nat_traversal
description: Set how the NAT mapping is kept open and discovered, while stopped

keepalive_sec.description: Keep-alive interval in seconds, up to 65535; 0 uses default (30)

send_options.description: Send OPTIONS instead of a keep-alive packet

use_public_addr.description: Use the address the server reports back (RFC3581)

name: esp_sip_service_set_register_refresh
description: Set how the registration is refreshed, while stopped; unused in P2P mode

interval_sec.description: Refresh interval in seconds, up to 65535; 0 uses default (3600)

suspend_on_call.description: Hold the refresh back while a call is up

name: esp_sip_service_set_srtp_mode
description: Set the SDES-SRTP negotiation mode while stopped

mode.description: off, prefer or required; omit to keep off

name: esp_sip_service_set_identity
description: Set how this endpoint names itself in outgoing requests, while stopped

user_agent.description: User-Agent header; omit to keep the stack default

domain.description: SIP URI host override; omit to use the uri host

name: esp_sip_service_set_frame_size
description: Set the RTP frame buffers handed to the protocol stack, while stopped

audio_max_bytes.description: Audio RTP frame buffer; 0 uses default (4096)

video_max_bytes.description: Video max frame length; 0 uses default (65536)

name: esp_sip_service_set_cache_size
description: Set the downlink track cache sizes while stopped

name: esp_sip_service_set_video_payload_type
description: Set the SDP payload type advertised for video, while stopped

payload_type.description: SDP payload type, up to 255; 0 uses the stack default

name: esp_sip_service_set_uri
description: Set the full SIP URI while stopped; does not change setup

uri.description: SIP URI as transport://user:password@server:port; empty password is user:@host

name: esp_sip_service_set_account
description: Build and set the SIP URI from account parts while stopped; does not change setup

transport.description: udp, tcp or tls; omit to use udp

password.description: SIP password; omit or empty becomes user:@host

name: esp_sip_service_set_local_addr
description: Set local IP while stopped; omit or empty lets the stack choose

ip.description: IPv4 address bound and advertised by the SIP stack

name: esp_sip_service_start
description: Start the SIP service, which registers with the server unless p2p_mode is set

name: esp_sip_service_stop
description: Stop the SIP service, hanging up any active call first

name: esp_sip_service_call
description: Place an outgoing call to a remote user or URI

remote_user.description: Remote user, extension or full URI to call

name: esp_sip_service_answer
description: Answer the ringing incoming call

name: esp_sip_service_bye
description: Hang up the active call or cancel the call being placed

name: esp_sip_service_send_dtmf
description: Send an out-of-band DTMF digit (RFC2833)

name: esp_sip_service_send_message
description: Send an out-of-dialog SIP MESSAGE request

content_type.description: Content-Type header; omit to use text/plain

peer_uri.description: Target URI; omit to send through the configured server
